## Flagship projects (verified, with numbers)
1. Warrant — deterministic authorization engine for AI agent commerce (TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, React). Signed spending warrants, 9 policy checks, 42/42 backend tests, 7-scenario adversarial suite all BLOCKED, SHA-256 hash-chained audit log. Live: https://warrant-nine.vercel.app · Repo: https://github.com/akshayrivers/Warrant
2. Yonro — grapheme-correct terminal text editor in Rust (custom buffer, binary layout tree, floating panes, Tokio plugin runtime, 18 unit tests, 7-suite benchmark runner). Repo: https://github.com/akshayrivers/Yonro-Text-Editor
3. DNS Resolver — RFC 1035 resolver in Rust (std-only): iterative resolution from roots, TTL-aware cache, A + AAAA records, packet telemetry, poison/spoof simulations. Repo: https://github.com/akshayrivers/DNS-Resolver
4. Grimoire — 15+ systems primitives from scratch: B/B+ trees (custom B-Tree search edged out std in Criterion benches), deletable Bloom filter (21.3M inserts/s, measured FPR within 0.05% of theory), Huffman coding, OSTEP lock-based concurrency in C, neural net from scratch in C. Repo: https://github.com/akshayrivers/Grimoire
5. Grandma's Launcher — accessibility-first Android launcher + Dockerized caretaker backend with magic-link auth and SOS live-location; RSA-2048 handshake at 2.75ms sign / 121µs verify.
6. AnonyMessages — anonymous messaging platform, OTP verification, live: https://anony-messages-seven.vercel.app
